# DOHM Digital Tools — Human and Agent Documentation

Read-only machine-readable discovery of published digital downloads; no A2A server, MCP endpoint, automated purchase, or guarantee of agent traffic.

## AI/LLM discovery
- [Product directory](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/agent-commerce/): browse verified published products, stated limits and seller links.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/agent-commerce/catalog.json): 8 published Gumroad products quality-cleared for this directory on 23 November 2026 (USD and EUR); products under rights or source review are excluded.
- [Technical/source](https://github.com/dohmnsama1-sketch/dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/tree/main/agent-commerce): open browser implementation and deterministic QA.

## Other independently useful free tools
- [Freelancer tools](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/free/)

- [GTA VI Creator Lab](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/gta6-creator/)

## Safety and buyer instructions
Never automate purchases without human approval. Prices, taxes, licenses and availability are confirmed by the final seller checkout. Content is not an endorsement by an LLM provider or a marketplace. No data is harvested by the directory.

## Free developer starter
- [Source Watch Lite](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/source-watch-lite/): MIT-licensed, Node.js 22+, one public HTTPS source SHA-256 drift checker; 26 regression tests. No agent/model fee or required paid service. [Code](https://github.com/dohmnsama1-sketch/dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/tree/main/source-watch-lite).

## AI-to-AI paid API services
- [Agent API payment tools](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/ai-to-ai/): transparent x402 USDC-on-Base email DNS evidence, domain company evidence, batch checking and public-web evidence. Buyer wallet approval and real service execution required.
- [Machine service pricing](https://dohmnsama1-sketch.github.io/ai-to-ai/services.json): published routes and machine-readable limits, paid calls are not automatically executed.
- [MCP discovery](https://tutevpsjeewjulryvvdo.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-gateway): route and quote discovery only, NOT an automatic payment facilitator.
